recipe.visualDefinition: A high-intensity, chaotic explosion of orange and red flames contained within a highly decorative, silver-toned baroque picture frame. The fire appears as a dense, roiling cloud of heat and smoke, filling the entire canvas area of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Containment of chaos within a rigid, formal structure
Contrast between the cool metallic frame and the hot organic fire
Juxtaposition of classical art presentation with destructive subject matter
coreInvariants: Ornate silver/pewter frame with floral and scrollwork carvings
Dense, textured fire filling the frame edge-to-edge
Absence of any visible background outside the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The fire is the central subject, scaled to fill the inner dimensions of the frame perfectly.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ornate carvings at the corners and center-points of the frame act as anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the structured, detailed edges of the frame inward to the swirling, amorphous textures of the fire.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame and the fire occupy the entire visual field.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant orange and deep red (fire) providing warmth and energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool silver and muted grey (frame) providing structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark charcoal and black (smoke) providing depth and shadow within the fire.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center (fire) against low saturation, metallic values on the perimeter (frame).
paletteRestrictions: Limit to fiery warm tones and metallic cool tones

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution image of a dense, roiling explosion of fire and smoke. Ensure the texture is thick and the colors range from bright yellow-orange to deep crimson.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a highly detailed, ornate silver baroque picture frame over the fire image, cropping the fire so it only appears within the inner border of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the frame detail sharp and metallic?
Does the fire look like a continuous explosion rather than individual flames?
Is the transition between the frame and the fire seamless?

adjustableVariables: Amount of black smoke vs bright flame
mustRedesign: Any text or logos present in the original source

mustAchieve: Intricate carving detail in the frame

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic metallic reflections on the frame.
Ensure the fire fills the frame without gaps.
Verify the color balance between warm and cool tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Intense Natural Phenomenon] with [Classical Formal Container] to create a surrealist juxtaposition.
